memories.content:
Joplin codebase analysis:
- Monorepo using Yarn workspaces and Lerna
- Key packages: app-desktop (Electron), app-mobile (React Native), server (Node.js), lib (shared)
- Main scripts: buildParallel/buildSequential, test-ci, linter, tsc
- Development tools: ESLint, TypeScript, Jest, Gulp
- Architecture: Multi-platform (desktop/mobile/web/server/cli) with shared core library

Desktop app console errors investigation:
1. React Router v7 warnings about v7_startTransition and v7_relativeSplatPath flags
2. No react-router found in app-desktop package.json or source files
3. Desktop app doesn't appear to use React Router at all
4. The warnings might be from a dependency or embedded content
5. inject_main.js and content.bundle.js errors are from browser extensions, not Joplin code
memories.context: User reported console errors in Joplin desktop app
